svg.data-psus: 1+1 hot-swap AC CRPS (550 W, 920 W or 1600 W by SKU), 0:1 / 1:1 modes
svg.data-poe-budget-note: high line, two supplies: 1550 W on the -24P (up to 17 ports at 90 W), 2910 W on the -48P/-48CP (up to 32 ports at 90 W); low line 1550 W and 1710 W
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 45 C (front to back airflow), 900 m; derate 1 C per 175 m above 900 m
svg.data-cpu: integrated ARM A55, 2C 1.5 GHz; Intel Denverton x86 4C 2.1 GHz (COMe) on the -48C/-48CP
svg.data-memory: 8 GB DDR4 (16 GB option on the -48C/-48CP)
svg.data-storage: 32 GB eMMC (ARM builds); 32 or 64 GB M.2 SSD (-48C/-48CP)
svg.data-poe: IEEE 802.3af/at/bt Type 4 Class 8, 90 W per port, persistent PoE - on the -24P, -48P and -48CP
svg.data-mgmt-ports: RJ45 console (9600 / 115200 default, 8N1), out-of-band combo pair (RJ45 in the stack and SFP left of the uplinks - one interface, not usable together), 2 x USB-A (data only)
svg.data-environment: EU RoHS, SVHC requirements of REACH directive
svg.data-emc: Class B - USA, Canada, Europe, Japan, China
svg.data-psu-approvals: CE, FCC, CCC, KC, TUV, UL / cUL, BIS and BSMI
